To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“the use of modern computers has led to the creation of a third branch of science, computational science.”
1) the computational approach is a valid and important third branch of scientific method, and 2) the computational approach can provide a new and powerful way of doing science and engineering.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing new mathematical and computational methods for the solution of problems in science and engineering.
developing the computational and mathematical tools that are needed to understand the complex systems of the world around us.
the development of computational methods, algorithms, and computer software to address the computational challenges of engineering and science.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of computational science and engineering is a necessary component of the research process in all fields of science and engineering.
computational engineering and science is a new branch of scientific methodology that is complementary to experimental and theoretical methodologies.
computational science is an important and necessary third leg on the stool of science and technology.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we are developing a new paradigm for computational engineering and science that is based on the integration of the three major branches of scientific methodology: experimental, theoretical, and computational.
our research is aimed at the development of computational methods for the solution of large scale, complex problems.
we are developing a new paradigm for scientific discovery and exploration, which we call computational science.
The main takeaway from our work is that
computational science is an important and exciting new discipline that is poised to make major contributions to the future of science and engineering.
the computational engineering and science program is not a program that can be developed overnight, but it is a program that must be nurtured, grown and sustained for many years.
the new methodology is not a mere adjunct to the traditional methods, but rather a new and independent scientific approach.
